Pin: smogon/pokemon-showdown `7244fe8e28fa8bc4d0809ae30d183c608b62bb2b`. Format: `gen9championsvgc2026regmc`. Mechanics config hash: `7b2bed9a269d3180a0608500b27f11503b052b453a81601cbf8ffe2429e7fa5a`. Adapter format: 1. Tracking: Redmine #917 (ADR-016), #936.

Areneon computes no stat, Speed or damage value: the pinned engine does, through the mechanics probe, and the engine is not independent of itself. This report lists what the probe's results were compared with, what they depend on, and what is not compared yet. Areneon makes **no claim of parity with the Pokémon Champions game**.

## Hand-worked fixtures

Synthetic sets (CC0) under `fixtures/mechanics/gen9championsvgc2026regmc/`. The SHA-256 is of the committed file.

### `speed/cases.json`

Speed order (hand-worked from the stat formula and the engine's modifier rules). SHA-256 `1daf2fe096066ac37708ac8585012a5fbf8a40bc731034e84b0613e3d7e0219e`, 20 cases.

| Case | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `priority-brackets` | Protect (+4) beats Fake Out (+3) beats a plain move (0) beats Dragon Tail (-6), whatever the Speed. |
| `speed-within-a-bracket-and-switch` | A switch is order 103: before every move. Moves of one priority go by Speed. |
| `exact-tie` | Equal Speed and priority is one group, never ordered: Venusaur against Venusaur, both 100. |
| `tailwind-doubles-speed` | Tailwind on side 0 doubles its Speed: Venusaur 100 x 2 = 200, ahead of Pikachu 156. |
| `trick-room-reverses` | Trick Room: the action speed is minus the Speed, so the slowest acts first. |
| `trick-room-speed-over-1809-acts-last` | No wrap in the champions mod: Speed 1872 under Trick Room is -1872, below Venusaur's -100, so it acts last. |
| `speed-over-1809-without-trick-room` | The same state without Trick Room: 1872 is the highest Speed and acts first. |
| `paralysis-halves-speed` | Paralysis halves Speed: Venusaur 100 becomes 50, behind Blastoise 98. |
| `choice-scarf-multiplies-by-1-5` | Choice Scarf: Venusaur 100 x 1.5 = 150, ahead of Garchomp 122 and behind Pikachu 156. |
| `boost-stages` | Stages: -1 is floor(100 / 1.5) = 66, +2 is 98 x 2 = 196. |
| `weather-cleared-by-the-declaration` | Ninetales' Drought sets sun at the start, but the declared weather is none: it is cleared, and Chlorophyll does not double Venusaur (100, behind Ninetales 120). |
| `declared-sun-doubles-chlorophyll` | With sun declared, Chlorophyll doubles Venusaur: 200, ahead of Pikachu 156. |
| `mega-becomes-faster-and-moves-first` | Gengar (130) is slower than Garchomp (140) before Mega Evolving and faster (150) after: the Evolution is its own group, then Gengar moves first. |
| `no-mega-control` | The same Pokemon without the Evolution: Gengar stays at 130, behind Garchomp 140. |
| `two-megas-in-speed-order` | Two Evolutions: Gengar (130 before) goes first, then Garchomp (122 before); afterwards Gengar is 150 and Garchomp 112. |
| `two-megas-tie` | Two Evolutions of equal Speed are one group, and so are their moves. |
| `already-evolved` | A Pokemon declared as already Mega Evolved is 150 with no Evolution of its own. |
| `quick-claw-is-unsupported` | Quick Claw draws a random number: the probe answers unsupported (random_effect) and names the action, never a guess. |
| `switch-before-mega` | A switch (order 103) comes before a Mega Evolution (order 104), which comes before the moves. |
| `four-actions-and-a-mega-make-five-groups` | Four actions with distinct keys and one Evolution give five groups: the Evolution's own and four of the actions. |

### `ko/cases.json`

KO counts (counted outside the probe from roll vectors; includes the boundary where the lowest roll equals HP and an explicit 256-pair enumeration). SHA-256 `06959d1495282ae252f49cc76f639a82e74fab9e7b3ac1ac495b99b47543fe1f`, 12 cases.

| Case | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `boundary-lowest-roll-equals-hp` | The lowest roll equals the HP: every roll reaches it |
| `boundary-one-above-lowest-roll` | HP one above the lowest roll: the lowest roll misses |
| `boundary-highest-roll-equals-hp` | HP equals the highest roll: only the highest roll reaches it |
| `boundary-above-highest-roll` | HP one above the highest roll: no one-hit KO |
| `zero-damage` | An immunity deals sixteen zeros: no count |
| `repeated-values` | A vector with repeated values counts every roll, not every distinct value |
| `explicit-256-pair-enumeration` | Every ordered pair (first roll row, second roll column) of the vector, written out as its sum; the count is the cells at or above the HP |
| `probe-hp-equals-lowest-roll` | Defender HP declared equal to the lowest no-crit roll: every roll is a KO |
| `probe-hp-one-above-lowest-roll` | One above the lowest roll: the two lowest rolls (both 91) miss |
| `probe-hp-equals-lowest-pair-sum` | HP equal to the lowest sum of two no-crit rolls: every pair is a two-hit KO |
| `probe-hp-one-above-lowest-pair-sum` | One above the lowest pair sum: the four pairs of the two lowest rolls miss |
| `probe-hp-above-highest-roll` | One above the highest no-crit roll: only the crit rolls reach it |

## KO counts and blockers

KO counts are integers, never a probability: `ohko_no_crit` and `ohko_crit` count the rolls (of 16) at or above the defender's current HP, `thko_no_crit` the ordered pairs of two independent no-crit rolls (of 256) whose sum is at least that HP, before the HP clamp and before damage-time effects. A defender holding a blocker gets `unsupported` counts (`ko_state_change`); the roll vectors are still returned. Residual damage, accuracy and multi-hit moves are out of scope.

- Blocking items (25): `airballoon`, `babiriberry`, `chartiberry`, `chilanberry`, `chopleberry`, `cobaberry`, `colburberry`, `ejectbutton`, `focusband`, `focussash`, `habanberry`, `kasibberry`, `kebiaberry`, `occaberry`, `oranberry`, `passhoberry`, `payapaberry`, `redcard`, `rindoberry`, `roseliberry`, `shucaberry`, `sitrusberry`, `tangaberry`, `wacanberry`, `yacheberry`
- Blocking abilities (13): `disguise`, `emergencyexit`, `flamebody`, `multiscale`, `mummy`, `pickpocket`, `sandspit`, `seedsower`, `spicyspray`, `stamina`, `sturdy`, `wanderingspirit`, `weakarmor`

## Calc divergences

| Case | Reason |
|---|---|
| `damage:always-crit:no_crit` | The fixture's no_crit vector for Frost Breath is the probe's forced non-crit run (willCrit set false to read the damage without the move's guaranteed critical hit); the calc ignores isCrit false for a move that always crits, so its no-crit list is the critical-hit list (the probe's crit vector for this case equals the calc's). Not a value error: a real Frost Breath always crits, and the hand-worked fixture decides (ADR-016 section 4). |
